decisions.reason: This industrial AC voltage input module is central to the firm's established automation platform and has visible commitment through its own page, so management would be very reluctant to withdraw it absent clear and persistent failure.
The solid state relay module fits naturally into the firm's modular control ecosystem, and existing development and production investments make continued support more likely than an early retreat.

The server room monitoring kit is more niche and less central than core modules, but because it reuses the firm's hardware, software and documentation base, management would still tend to keep it and treat weak demand as potentially temporary.

Although the RGB LED control module is somewhat less central to the announced strategic direction, it remains a close extension of the modular platform and is therefore more likely to be retained than discontinued quickly.

The remote access service for wallboxes directly supports the firm's stated expansion in charging and energy management, so public strategic commitment and accumulated investment make withdrawal especially unlikely.
